messages:
sam: Anyone seeing SSE connections go quiet for ~20-40s then suddenly continue? Customers report gaps in streaming responses but our console shows the stream as still OPEN :confused:
elaine: saw a cluster of these at 15:03 UTC on prod-west, maybe tied to proxy backpressure. clients don't always send a full close, just vanish then reconnect.
mike: logs look like proxy sends a soft 'pingback' to slow clients, then we see a flurry of reconnects. snippet:
```
  PROXY[proxy-12]: apply_backpressure route=/v1/stream idle_grace=20000
  PROXY[proxy-12]: pingback sent id=0x8f3 wait_ms=25000
  CLIENT[client-7]: no activity
  CLIENT[client-7]: reconnect ts=5234567910 resume_token=abc123
```
ana: console telemetry only counts connection opens/closes. no metric for 'soft pingbacks' or proxied idle_grace. so dashboard stays flat which is confusing for support.
julian: agree — we need a 1) metric for pingback_sent, pingback_ack, and 2) a tag for route/shard so we can split by tenant. otherwise rollouts become guesswork.
sam: proposal: increase proxy idle_grace from 20s -> 30s in canary to reduce false reconnects, and add a transient metric pingback_wait_ms to show configured window.
mike: also consider emitting a trace header on the original event so we can correlate in logs: `X-Stream-Probe: <probe-id>` and surface that in console traces.
elaine: UX note: in the console, show a small warning when pingback rate > 0.5% of streams for a route. helps SREs triage faster.
nana: +1, but telemetry ingestion costs — make the metric sampled (1/10) by default, with full sampling on dedicated customers.
julian: rollout plan: canary proxy config change in prod-west for 1h, instrument metrics + trace header, then evaluate reconnect spike. if reconnects drop by >30% keep; otherwise revert.
sam: SGTM. who owns the instrumentation + console UX?
mike: I'll add the metric emission in proxy (takes ~2h dev + unit tests).
elaine: I'll mock the console banner and flag behind a feature toggle.
nana: I'll add ingestion sampling + a retention note for billing.
julian: I'll book the canary window and own the rollout orchestration. @deploy-bot can you schedule the canary for 16:00 UTC and attach runbook? :calendar: 
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by julian: env=prod-west start=2026-03-21T16:00:00Z duration=1h change=proxy_idle_grace_20->30 metrics=[pingback_sent,pingback_ack,pingback_wait_ms] runbook=https://go/runbooks/stream-pingback-canary
sam: thanks. after canary we'll look at per-tenant deltas and decide if we need longer-term changes (sticky routing, explicit client heartbeats, or reverting to hard disconnects).
julian: quick note for post-canary: collect a small sample of raw client sockets (anonymized) to see if certain SDKs are more prone to silent pauses.
mike: added a small log line for probe-id correlation and a config flag for sampling in the PR. linking when ready.
elaine: thanks all, will update the console PR link here.
sam: resolving action items: mike (proxy metric + header), elaine (console flag+banner), nana (ingest sampling), julian (canary orchestration). followups in #eng-platform. :thumbsup:
